subject: Re: Proposed Amendment — Throughput Rebalance & SOW Edits
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@pinegrovehealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Rebalance committed throughput & SOW edits

Hi Rafael / Laura / Karthik,

Thanks again for the QBR earlier — following internal capacity forecasting we need to propose a redistribution of our committed throughput across two product lines (Clinical NLP and Insights). The change will shift ~30% of committed throughput from Insights to Clinical NLP starting May 1.

Can Redwood send: 1) an amendment or change order that reassigns the throughput buckets and shows the prorated fees for the remainder of the term, 2) a short SOW edit that clarifies implementation milestones for the Clinical NLP ingest work, and 3) the procurement-friendly order form PDF (we need to attach to the PO).

Attached: Pinegrove_OrderForm_v3.pdf — current order form.
Timeline: Procurement needs final paperwork the week of Mar 28 to meet our internal PO schedule (PO-38921). If you expect legal to need more time, please call that out and give the timeline you’d be able to meet.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Li
Head of Platform Integrations
Pinegrove Health
emma.li@pinegrovehealth.com
+1 415-555-0172
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rebalance committed throughput & SOW edits

Emma — appreciate the clear ask. High-level plan:

- We can do a one-page Order Form amendment that reallocates the committed throughput across SKUs and includes a prorated fee table for the remainder of the current term.
- We'll include a short SOW addendum describing the additional implementation work (data mapping + ingest window + acceptance criteria).
- Legal will need to update Exhibit B (fee schedule) and add a change order signature block.

Next steps: I’ll run numbers on the prorate and share an internal calc, then loop Legal (Karthik). Can Laura own the implementation SOW wording and the implementation milestone dates? I propose delivery of a redline draft by Thu, Mar 24 so you can route to procurement by Mar 28. If that timeline misses anything let me know.

I've attached an internal calc showing the proposed dollar impact and the example prorate rows.

Attachments: RWI_Initial_Calc.xlsx

— Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@pinegrovehealth.com>; procurement@pinegrovehealth.com
Date: 2028-03-22T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rebalance committed throughput & SOW edits

Rafael / Laura — quick legal note based on Rafael's plan and the attached order form:

Inline summary of required redlines (high level):
1) Order Form: add an "Order Form Amendment" page that lists the original Order Form reference + amended SKUs/committed throughput. Include both original and new monthly committed tokens/units for clarity.
2) Fee Schedule (Exhibit B): show prorated charge rows and the proration date (May 1 start). Calculate fee credits for the Insights SKU where capacity is being moved; confirm whether Pinegrove wants those credits applied as refund or as future-term credit.
3) Term / Billing: add a proration clause and confirm invoice path — Redwood invoices on the 1st of the month; specify whether Pinegrove prefers a one-time adjustment invoice or line-item credits applied against future invoices.
4) SOW Addendum: implementation milestones, acceptance criteria, and a 2-week cutover window. Make sure to keep acceptance language consistent with the MSA to avoid scope creep.
5) Signatures: single amendment signature block (PO and Redwood signatories) — procurement will need a printable PDF for the PO attachment.

I’m attaching a redline draft of the Order Form/Exhibit B (word doc) with placeholders for the monetary proration and two suggested billing options. If Pinegrove confirms the billing preference we can finalize the numeric rows and push to DocuSign.

Attachments: RWI_OrderForm_Redline_Draft.docx

Timing: If Rafael sends the final numbers today, I can produce a legal redline for review by EOD Mar 23 and deliver a PDF for procurement by Mar 24 — that should allow Pinegrove to sign and issue PO-38921 by Mar 28. If you need the PDF earlier, advise and we'll prioritize.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal — Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@pinegrovehealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pinegrovehealth.com; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-23T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rebalance committed throughput & SOW edits

Thanks — that timeline works. Procurement will accept a one-time adjustment invoice applied as a credit against next invoice (that simplifies our internal accounting).

We’ve attached PO-38921.pdf (internal PO) for reference. Please proceed with the redline using the credit option, and include the short SOW addendum with milestones: kickoff (May 2), ingest window (May 8–May 22), acceptance testing (May 23–June 6).

If possible, route the final printable PDF to procurement@pinegrovehealth.com and I’ll confirm signatory names.

— Emma
